address: MiCasa All Suite Hotel, 368B Jalan Tun Razak, Taman U Thant, Kuala Lumpur, 50400, Malaysia
bio: One of the city's favourite formal dining spots, Cilantro impresses with meticulous French fare that showcases first-rate Japanese ingredients. The food ranges from classic French to adventurous Japanese-French fusion. In addition to à la carte choices, the Japanese chef proposes various set menus and prix-fixes. Try his signature cold capellini with sauces and accompaniments that change with the seasons. They are open for lunch on Fridays only....
